title: Meta's MMS speech models cover over 1,100 languages using Bible recordings

items.meta_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2305.13516: Scaling Speech Technology to 1,000+ Languages
passages: The Massively Multilingual Speech (MMS) project increases the number of supported languages by 10-40x, depending on the task.

We built pre-trained wav2vec 2.0 models covering 1,406 languages, a single multilingual automatic speech recognition model for 1,107 languages, speech synthesis models for the same number of languages, as well as a language identification model for 4,017 languages.

Experiments show that our multilingual speech recognition model more than halves the word error rate of Whisper on 54 languages of the FLEURS benchmark while being trained on a small fraction of the labeled data.
However, current speech technology is restricted to about one hundred languages which is a small fraction of the over 7,000 languages spoken around the world.
Expanding the language coverage of speech technology has the potential to improve access to information for many more people.
The main ingredients are a new dataset based on readings of publicly available religious texts and effectively leveraging self-supervised learning.
